abstract: Cognitive radios are essential concept to transfer from legacy spectrum system to dynamic one. Cognitive radios are brilliant technology, capable to sense the radio environment and reconfigure the system parameters in dynamic network. Cognitive radio network includes multiple features of ad hoc network. These features includes distributed system with multihop framework, opportunistic spectrum system, alternative network topology. Cognitive radio features required to find accurate spectrum portion to successfully deploy cognitive radio ad hoc network. Several users of cognitive network in spectrum sensing cooperative environment detects the active or passive status of primary users. This technique helps to enhance the detection performance of users. Ad hoc network have no central system for data fusion it is crucial to distribute the spectrum sensing network fully cooperative in nature. This study is focus to create cooperative environment based spectrum sensing network for cognitive radio ad hoc networks. The analysis is depends on viewing of reliable sensing and less energy consumption. The contribution of this research is to design context aware framework for distributed system and mobile cognitive radio ad hoc network. This study contribute to avoid Insistent Spectrum Sensing Data Falsification (ISSDF) attacks.

articleTitle: A CAD Tool for Breast Cancer Prediction using Naive Bayes Classifier
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Even though today's medical field is technologically advanced, some diseases still haunt the human race by posing a hustle in its existence. In addition to the sophisticated tools and techniques for disease diagnosis, recent use of information and communication technology (ICT) has also tightened its spine to serve this noble cause. To have an interior view of the body without surgery, medical imaging is a predominant technique behind early/automatic diagnosing and detecting diseases. Image mammography is the primary asset assisting doctors for having a projection of the interiors of breast tissues, thus offering a crucial big stick in the diagnosis of malignancy/non- malignancy in the tissues. Using certain supervised and unsupervised filters offered by Weka on top of BCDR-F01 cancer benhcmark dataset, this work intends to increase the objectivity of clinical diagnostics. Misclassification cost of Naive Bayes algorithm is measured and compared the same with misclassification cost measured after applying respective filters. The results show the accuracies in case of supervised attribute DISCRETIZE filter, supervised instance RESAMPLE filter and unsupervised attribute PKIIDiscretize filter get amplified from 73.7569 % to 81.768 %, 85.0829 %, and 78.7293 % and only in case of unsupervised instance RESAMPLE filter, it shows a minute decrease to 73.4807 %.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Artificial Neural Network and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The Heart diseases are primary purpose behind death in 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century. Coronary illness is the main issue looked by the present reality. The deaths caused by the coronary illness are expanding step by step in recent years. Social and individual percentage of these diseases can be decreased by early recognition of coronary illness. This would give the means that may accommodate to moderate movement of the diseases and also to recuperate patient to great wellbeing. In this paper, different image processing techniques are proposed for getting useful information from medical reports of patients using artificial neural network.

articleTitle: Capacity Aware Resource Allocation in Millimeter Wave Micro Urban Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In this changing world, with the advent of technology, users are increasing massively, so are the demands. To cater such demands, there is a need of extensively high bandwidth. Moreover, the current technology of LTE is making is difficult for users to explore the modern technologies like Big Data, IoT fully. Thus, there is a need to move from LTE to 5G. The upcoming 5G emphasizes mainly on providing the following Six requirements i.e, higher capacity, extensively higher data rates, lower End-to-End latency, enormous device-to-device connectivity, less cost and consistent resourcing of Quality of Experience. To address that, 5G implements millimeter Wave which is unused and unlicensed spectrum between 30–300 GHz. In addition to this, the resources are allocated to the system in such a way that each cell is able to use the resources uniformly. In this paper, a hybrid heterogeneous system model is constructed, which has the potential to be working in multi-tier system. In such multi-tier system, one tier is proposed which is comprising of geographic region lying in the Macro base station range which communicates with the small cell base stations using RF communication and the other tier consisting of the region which uses millimeter Wave to communicate within the base stations and UE. A new optimal resource allocation algorithm has been proposed for our multi-tier heterogeneous network which will work upon and analyze the scenario of micro urban and accordingly find out the best possible cell arrangement.

articleTitle: Predictive Technique Of Task Scheduling For BigData In Cloud
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In the current era, Big data utilizes MapReduce strategies in task scheduling, most notably, Apache Hadoop, a programming library and framework that considers the distributed processing of enormous data across clusters of computers using simple programming models. Still, there persist longer wait times with MapReduce technique. Because, the scheduling in Cloud with huge data causes frequent obstructions to effective computing, prompting prolonged makespan, longer waiting time and expenses acquired by the client and the server end. Task Scheduling with a huge measure of information data can cause obstacles to proficient processing. The motive of this work is to accomplish the desired solution to overcome the issues obstructing the effective CPU/task Scheduling of VMs in the Cloud environment with massive data without the use of any complex algorithms. This paper presents a predictive task scheduling approach and introduces PCA (Principal component analysis) and utilizes nine different Machine classifiers and compares the results of the accuracy and time obtained by each ML classifiers with and without the use of PCA. Results are visualized and the percentage variation of comparison is discussed. Experiments are carried out in the Hadoop Environment, using MapReduce the dataset is generated and ML classifiers are executed in Python.
